mapper.sql: id, name, address, longitude, latitude, business_type, intro, food_contact_name, food_contact_phone, food_recommended_dishes, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM business WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM business WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE business SET name=#{name},address=#{address},longitude=#{longitude},latitude=#{latitude},intro=#{intro},food_contact_name=#{foodContactName},food_contact_phone=#{foodContactPhone},food_recommended_dishes=#{foodRecommendedDishes} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE business SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE business SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT fr.id AS resource_id,fr.public_url,bfr.sort_no FROM business_file_relation bfr JOIN file_resource fr ON fr.id=bfr.file_resource_id WHERE bfr.business_id=#{businessId} AND fr.status='ACTIVE' AND fr.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY bfr.sort_no ASC,bfr.file_resource_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_resource WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id IN #{id}
